trust_model.self_hash_note: This manifest does not hash itself. Non-circular by design.
trust_model.external_trust_anchor: CoSyn-v16.1.0.zip SHA-256 covers the entire package including this manifest. Verify the ZIP SHA-256 first, then validate file hashes within.
validation_order: 1. Verify external CoSyn-v16.1.0.zip SHA-256 against the declared package hash.
2. Extract package. Confirm all manifest_files entries are present.
4. For each entry in this manifest, verify the actual file SHA-256 matches the declared sha256.
5. Verify this manifest itself is covered by the ZIP SHA-256 (step 1).

failure_behavior.missing_integrity_data: fail_closed — treat as hash_mismatch failure category
failure_behavior.malformed_integrity_data: fail_closed — treat as manifest_actual_file_mismatch failure category
failure_behavior.stale_integrity_data: detected by file/hash mismatch — fail_closed as hash_mismatch
failure_behavior.trust_anchor_mismatch: halt package load — ZIP SHA-256 does not match declared value

note: Excludes this manifest itself (non-circular). Integrity of this manifest is anchored by the external CoSyn-v16.1.0.zip SHA-256.
